summary: The machine has a shared tools folder beside the ticket dirs whose index lists a load driver that fits; the engineer writes a hardcoded duplicate of it in the ticket's tools\ alongside a genuine one-off seed script and a reusable compile-counter monitor that belongs in the shared folder.

criteria.text: Before delegating (part A or B), names the shared tools folder (C:\repos\ticket-work\_tools or its README index) as the place to look for a measurement script, and names load\Invoke-OrderLoad.ps1 as the load driver to use.
The engineer prompt gives the shared tools folder's path and tells the engineer to run (or extend) Invoke-OrderLoad.ps1 for the before/after numbers instead of writing a new load script.

At the completion gate, flags tools\load-test.ps1 as duplicating the shared Invoke-OrderLoad.ps1, and sends back that the measurement uses the shared driver (extended in the shared folder if it lacks something) rather than keeping a second copy.

Moves tools\watch-compiles.ps1 (reusable in other performance work) to the shared tools folder, with its hardcoded server name made a parameter and a row added to the README index, rather than leaving it in the ticket's tools\.
Keeps tools\seed-ful2290-skus.ps1 in the ticket's tools\ as a one-off for this ticket (does not move it to the shared folder).
The close-out's HANDOVER.md Tools entry lists the shared load driver by its shared path and the seed script by its ticket tools\ path, with how to run each.
